profile_text: With a strong presence in the information and communication sector, this Düsseldorf-based firm specializes in electronic data services, leveraging its expertise to drive growth. As a scaler, it has achieved a remarkable 47.1% increase in employees, reaching 50 staff members in 2024, indicating a rising demand for its data management solutions. Located at Graf-Adolf-Straße 35-37, the company continues to expand its services, solidifying its position in the market.
